{"metadata":{"description":"Hold-to-talk voice input for the DeepSeek Harness web composer: hold the mouse on the input box, speak, release to insert the text into the draft. Local SenseVoice ASR via sherpa-onnx: no API key, offline, audio never leaves the machine. | DSH 长按说话语音输入插件:输入框上按住鼠标说话,浮层边说边出字,松手把文字写","id":"gh:1365971776","install_available":true,"language":"JavaScript","name":"dsh-hold-to-talk","slug":"wangzhanchao883/dsh-hold-to-talk","topics":["asr","audio","deepseek-harness","dictation","dsh","dsh-plugin","hold-to-talk","local-first","nodejs","offline","plugin","privacy","push-to-talk","sensevoice","sherpa-onnx","speech-to-text","voice","voice-input","wechat","wechat-desktop"]},"paragraphs":[{"id":"p1s1","text":"Hold-to-talk voice input for the DeepSeek Harness web composer: hold the mouse on the input box, spe"},{"id":"p1s2","text":"ak, release to insert the text into the draft. Local SenseVoice ASR via sherpa-onnx: no API key, off"},{"id":"p1s3","text":"line, audio never leaves the machine. | DSH 长按说话语音输入插件:输入框上按住鼠标说话,浮层边说边出字,松手把文字写"},{"id":"p2s1","text":"# dsh-hold-to-talk"},{"id":"p3s1","text":"**Hold-to-talk voice input for the DeepSeek Harness Web composer** — the WeChat-desktop gesture: hol"},{"id":"p3s2","text":"d the mouse on the input box, speak, see the running transcript float above it, release to drop the "},{"id":"p3s3","text":"text into the draft. Recognition runs **locally** (SenseVoice via sherpa-onnx): no API key, offline,"},{"id":"p3s4","text":" audio never leaves the machine."},{"id":"p4s1","text":"**DSH Web 输入框的"长按说话"语音输入** —— 微信电脑版同款操作：在输入框上按住鼠标说话，浮层里边说边出字，松手把文字写进输入框，上滑取消。识别全部在**本机**跑（SenseVoice"},{"id":"p4s2","text":" + sherpa-onnx），免密钥、离线、音频不出本机。"},{"id":"p5s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p6s1","text":"English · 中文说明"},{"id":"p7s1","text":"### What it does"},{"id":"p8s1","text":"- A long press on the composer starts dictation; releasing inserts the transcript into the draft; sl"},{"id":"p8s2","text":"iding up cancels; `Esc` cancels; a 60-second hold auto-finishes.
- While you speak, an overlay above"},{"id":"p8s3","text":" the composer shows a live transcript, a level meter and the elapsed time.
- The live transcript is "},{"id":"p8s4","text":"a **preview only** — it is never written into the draft. Only the release-time result (decoded from "},{"id":"p8s5","text":"the full audio) is inserted, so recognition jitter cannot corrupt what you are editing.
- Recognitio"},{"id":"p8s6","text":"n is local: SenseVoice (int8) through sherpa-onnx, decoded in a worker thread. No API key, no cloud "},{"id":"p8s7","text":"call, no telemetry.
- Normal editing is untouched: a quick click still places the caret, dragging st"},{"id":"p8s8","text":"ill selects text, and holding without reaching the threshold does nothing."},{"id":"p9s1","text":"### Requirements"},{"id":"p10s1","text":"- DeepSeek Harness running the **web** profile (`dsh web`).
- Node.js `>=22.19` or `>=24` on the mac"},{"id":"p10s2","text":"hine running DSH.
- A Chromium-based browser (Chrome / Edge) with microphone access. The DSH web UI
"},{"id":"p10s3","text":"is served over `http://127.0.0.1`, which is a secure context, so `getUserMedia`
is allowed.
- ~230 M"},{"id":"p10s4","text":"B of disk for the model, downloaded once on first use."},{"id":"p11s1","text":"### How it works"},{"id":"p12s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p13s1","text":"Engineering decisions worth knowing:"},{"id":"p14s1","text":"- **Decoding runs in a worker thread.** sherpa-onnx decoding is synchronous and
blocks for 0.6–3.3 s"},{"id":"p14s2","text":" per 6–22 s of audio; on the main thread it would stall the
host event loop and the page's streaming"},{"id":"p14s3","text":" output with it.
- **Native first, WASM fallback.** `sherpa-onnx-node` (native, multi-threaded) is
~"},{"id":"p14s4","text":"2.5× faster than `sherpa-onnx` (WASM, single-threaded) — see the table below.
WASM lives in `optiona"},{"id":"p14s5","text":"lDependencies`; the worker falls back automatically.
- **Absolute model paths only.** The WASM build"},{"id":"p14s6","text":" uses NODERAWFS; a relative path
lands in emscripten's virtual CWD and is not found.
- **The `AudioC"},{"id":"p14s7","text":"ontext` is created inside the `mousedown` gesture.** Creating it
400 ms later gets it suspended by a"},{"id":"p14s8","text":"utoplay policy and no audio flows. The
capture node feeds a zero-gain sink before `destination` so i"},{"id":"p14s9","text":"t is pulled
without being audible (otherwise: feedback howl).
- **Resampling always restarts from sa"},{"id":"p14s10","text":"mple 0**, so successive increments tile the
stream exactly; resampling only the tail would drift.
- "},{"id":"p14s11","text":"**Previews wait for 2 seconds of audio.** A non-streaming model fed too little
hallucinates (1.2 s p"},{"id":"p14s12","text":"roduced "哈。", 0.5 s produced "Yeah.").
- **Late previews are dropped by epoch**, so a preview arrivi"},{"id":"p14s13","text":"ng after release can
never overwrite the final transcript.
- **Gesture ownership is decided by DOM c"},{"id":"p14s14","text":"ontainment, never by visibility.** The
overlay is hidden while idle; dispatching by `offsetParent`/`"},{"id":"p14s15","text":"getClientRects()`
made long-press die permanently after the first successful dictation (v0.1.0).
- *"},{"id":"p14s16","text":"*The overlay anchor is always rendered** (zero-size, out of flow) so the
ownership anchor never disa"},{"id":"p14s17","text":"ppears, and a module token makes the previous
module's document listeners inert after a hot reload."},{"id":"p15s1","text":"### Limitations"},{"id":"p16s1","text":"- SenseVoice is **not** a streaming model. "Live" is a re-decode of the tail
window every 1.5 s, so "},{"id":"p16s2","text":"the preview trails speech by roughly 1.5–2 s; the final
result (on release) always uses the complete"},{"id":"p16s3","text":" audio.
- Long dictation takes a moment to finish: ~3 s for 20 s of speech, ~9 s at the
60 s cap.
- "},{"id":"p16s4","text":"**Desktop mouse only.** Touch long-press is deliberately not implemented — it
collides with text sel"},{"id":"p16s5","text":"ection and the context menu on mobile.
- The model download is 228 MB on first use."},{"id":"p17s1","text":"### Security"},{"id":"p18s1","text":"- **Audio never leaves the machine.** It travels only over loopback HTTP to the
plugin's own route a"},{"id":"p18s2","text":"nd is decoded by a local process. No third-party service is
contacted during recognition.
- **No cre"},{"id":"p18s3","text":"dentials.** The plugin reads and stores no API key or token.
- **Routes refuse cross-site requests**"},{"id":"p18s4","text":" (`sec-fetch-site`), so a random web page
cannot post audio at the local server.
- **The microphone "},{"id":"p18s5","text":"is opened only while you hold**; the stream's tracks are
stopped on release, and no other page or pr"},{"id":"p18s6","text":"ocess gets the audio.
- The only network request the plugin makes by itself is the one-time model
do"},{"id":"p18s7","text":"wnload from the configured mirror (`hf-mirror.com` by default). No telemetry."},{"id":"p19s1","text":"### 环境要求"},{"id":"p20s1","text":"- DeepSeek Harness，运行 **web** profile（`dsh web`）。
- 运行 DSH 的机器上 Node.js `>=22.19` 或 `>=24`。
- Chromi"},{"id":"p20s2","text":"um 系浏览器（Chrome / Edge）并允许麦克风。DSH Web 走 `http://127.0.0.1`，属安全上下文，`getUserMedia` 可用。
- 首次使用需要约 230MB "},{"id":"p20s3","text":"器（Chrome / Edge）并允许麦克风。DSH Web 走 `http://127.0.0.1`，属安全上下文，`getUserMedia` 可用。
- 首次使用需要约 230MB 磁盘放模型。"},{"id":"p21s1","text":"### 已知限制"},{"id":"p22s1","text":"- **不是流式模型**：SenseVoice 是非流式识别，"实时"是每 1.5 秒重解码尾部窗口做出来的预览，因此预览比说话滞后约 1.5~2 秒；定稿（松手）永远用完整音频，结果最准。
- **"},{"id":"p22s2","text":"长语音定稿要等**：说 20 秒约等 3 秒。60 秒上限约 9 秒。
- **仅桌面鼠标**：没有实现 touch 长按（移动端长按会与文本选择/上下文菜单冲突），故意留空。
- **麦克风需要安全"},{"id":"p22s3","text":"上下文**：`http://127.0.0.1` 属安全上下文，可用；若通过局域网 IP 访问需 https。
- 首次下载 228MB 模型；`~/.dsh` 所在盘需留出空间。"}],"truncated":true}
